Subject: Unexpected June invoice delta — GCP marketplace (CloudPartner)

Hi Rafael / Marissa,

We're seeing a ~2.7% positive delta on our June GCP Marketplace invoice compared to our internal meter (attached snapshot). The line-level breakout looks like several high-volume SKUs were billed in a single hourly bucket instead of the per-minute granularity we expect — the invoice shows a rounding/aggregation shift that inflated the billed quantity.

Can Redwood confirm whether there was a change to the metering windowing or aggregation on your side during the June 28–30 timeframe? We need: 
- a short reconciliation (delta by SKU)
- raw usage excerpt (CSV) for the affected hour ranges
- VAT/Invoice evidence we can use for our local tax reclaim if this gets corrected retroactively

Attachment: gcp-usage-snapshot-2028-07-01.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)
Attachment: cloudpartner_gcp_invoice_June2028.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

Appreciate a quick triage — this is timing-sensitive for our month-end close.

Thanks,

Hi all — quick technical triage notes (preliminary):

Summary: During the nightly ingestion on 2028-06-29 we had a short-lived fallback in the aggregator that caused minute-level events arriving with sub-minute timestamps to be coalesced into the nearest hourly window for a subset of SKUs when the usual streaming pipeline fell back to batch replay.
Impact: ~2.2–3.0% overcount on the affected SKUs for the 22:00–23:00 UTC window. The root trigger was an upstream kafka partition rebalancing that delayed ordering metadata for ~4 minutes; when the batch replay executed it used a conservative aggregate window which we reverted in the hotfix.

Attachments: ingest-log-snippet.txt (text, 48KB) — contains the replay job id and sample offsets.

Immediate remediation options:
- Option A (recommended): produce a retroactive per-minute reconciliation and issue a credit against the June invoice for the measured delta; this requires us to compute token-level quantities and provide CSVs + a corrected invoice stub. Estimated work: 6–8 engineer-hours.
- Option B: apply a one-off manual adjustment to the next invoice (less preferred for audit trail).

I can produce the per-minute reconciliation artifact by EOD today (2028-07-08) and a credit memo by Wednesday. Rafael — will route the finalized artifacts to Neha for VAT evidence packaging.

-- Jonas
Site Reliability / Ingest
Redwood Inference
